body:
In a [different issue comment](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2553#issuecomment-2755528183), @jmanico said:

> v6
> 
> V1.6 Cryptographic Inventory and Documentation
> V6.2 Algorithms
> V6.3 Random Values
> V6.5 Encryption Algorithms
> V6.6 Hashing and Hash-based Functions
> V6.7 Public Key Cryptography
> V6.8 In-Use Data Cryptography
> V6.9 Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC)
> 
> Note: Putting primitives up front in this list
> 
> v9
> 
> V9.4 General TLS Security Guidance
> V9.1 HTTPS Communication with External Facing Services
> V9.3 HTTPS Communication between Internal Services
> V9.2 General Service to Service Communication Security
> 
> Note: Putting External (which is more important) up front

Having discussed with Elar he said there is still room for rearranging here so I want to take a look at these and potentially rearrange the sections

comments.body:
On V6, the only differences to where we are now are with V6.3, V6.5 and V6.6. I think having V6.3 lower down as it doesn't have an L1 req makes sense but I think 6.5 should be before 6.6 as has two L1s and is probably more widely relevant.

On V9, I can understand both perspectives on the order but I am inclined to agree with Jim that 9.1 should be after 9.4 but I still think that 9.2 provides general cases for service to service/internal and then 9.3 provides more specific cases.

labels.description: This needs to be addressed to prepare 5.0

title: Consider V6 and V9 section order
